items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: I know him well. ... John Lennon just had this thought that when you get in professional horn players that something magic just happens. ... Like they know what parts to play.

ctx.x: Oh sure. I know him well.
And he talked about getting a call to play a John Lennon session, which I know you had done.
